summary: The main article describes a visible light-promoted synthesis of pyrrolidinone derivatives using Rose Bengal as a photoredox catalyst, supported by 4 tables for optimization and substrate scope, and 3 schemes for mechanism and control. The experimental section provides detailed characterization data for 26 specific products (4a-11d).
